consumables.description: +1 Armor and +1 Resist for the rest of the Battle, and you are immune to Burn.
consumables.intent: Burn immunity is a flat answer to an entire archetype, and the two points of mitigation are almost an afterthought.
consumables.source: Hell-TCG name reused (potion, Dragon's Blood — the Dragon's Blood badge is campaign-tier; the combat half rebuilt as burn immunity)

consumables.name: Inquisitor's Scroll
consumables.description: remove 5 Burn from every ally within 4 hexes. Every enemy within 4 hexes gains 4 Poison. Area effect: no roll, no crit.
consumables.intent: It cleans the party and salts the ground in the same motion, and it cannot crit because nothing that does not roll ever can.
consumables.source: Hell-TCG name reused (potion, Inquisitor's Scroll — the class-conditional half folded in and scoped to hexes)

consumables.name: Knight's Boon Water
consumables.description: +2 Armor and +2 Resist for the rest of the Battle, and heal 6.
consumables.intent: Four points of mitigation on one hero for the rest of the fight, which is what a tier-3 bottle is supposed to buy.
consumables.source: Hell-TCG name reused (potion, Knight's Boon Water — the class gate repealed; the numbers kept)

consumables.name: Draining Elixir
consumables.description: Heal 20 and remove 5 Burn and 5 Poison. For the rest of the Battle you have -1 Stamina Max and -10 Accuracy.
consumables.intent: It brings a hero back from nothing and hands you a worse hero than the one you saved, which is exactly the right price.
consumables.source: Hell-TCG name reused (potion, Draining Elixir — 'Gain Drained' rebuilt as a stamina and Accuracy tax, since Drained is a campaign badge)
